name: DashPilot AI
description: A local, game-aware Geometry Dash autopilot with an in-game control panel and adaptive retry memory.

strength.name: Strength
strength.description: How early the controller reacts. Higher values increase its look-ahead window and control commitment.

auto-start-on-level.name: Auto-start on level entry
auto-start-on-level.description: Arm the bot automatically whenever a playable level opens.

auto-retry.name: Retry after death
auto-retry.description: Automatically restart after a short death-animation delay.

debug-overlay.name: Debug overlay
debug-overlay.description: Show the live decision, next hazard distance, mode, and compact object grid in the in-game panel.

toggle-bot.name: Arm / toggle autopilot
toggle-bot.description: Can be pressed in the menu to arm the bot for the next level, or during gameplay to take control immediately.
